stemMarkdown: Three pipes A, B and C can fill a tank in 12, 30 and 60 hours respectively. If all three are opened together, how many hours will the tank take to fill? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Combined rate $= \dfrac{1}{12} + \dfrac{1}{30} + \dfrac{1}{60} = 0.133333$ tanks per hour, so the time is $7.5$ hours.
